celestial object type

  • CURIE: gmeow:celestialObjectType
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/celestialObjectType
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The kind(s) of a celestial location (one or more gmeow:CelestialObjectType individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (e.g. a source classified as both 'star' and 'variable star') and must coexist as evidence.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CelestialLocation -> gmeow:CelestialObjectType

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:celestialObjectType from gmeow:CelestialLocation to gmeow:CelestialObjectType when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:CelestialLocation, gmeow:CelestialObjectType
